tasks.title: Deliver the first runnable product outcome
tasks.objective: Implement the earliest user/operator-visible workflow across every required code layer so the product can be tried immediately, with focused verification and no deferred integration hidden behind mocks.

verification.procedure: Run focused checks and one bounded behavioral smoke for the first runnable product outcome and its required failure behavior.
verification.expected_result: The first approved workflow starts or executes in the declared local mode, can be tried through its intended interface, its focused checks pass, and no forbidden side effect occurs.
verification.evidence_required: Sanitized command, exit code, key assertions, cleanup result, and source fingerprint.
verification.cleanup: Stop task-owned processes and remove only task-owned temporary artifacts.

tasks.title: Complete the connected MVP system
tasks.objective: Complete the remaining approved backend, data, provider, integration, feature, and usability work required for one independently usable MVP, then prove the connected success and failure paths.

verification.procedure: Run the focused unit and integration checks plus one bounded behavioral smoke for the complete core workflow.
verification.expected_result: The approved happy path and material failure paths work end to end without optimistic or fabricated success state.
verification.evidence_required: Sanitized commands, exit codes, key assertions, smoke result, cleanup result, and source fingerprint.
verification.cleanup: Stop task-owned processes and remove only task-owned temporary artifacts.

tasks.title: Run the final integrated product audit
tasks.objective: Run milestone-level convergence and prepare exact evidence, limitations, and handoff for the owner without inferring final acceptance.

verification.procedure: Run the full applicable regression, security or secret checks, and real behavioral/manual product trial against the final source state. Repair in-scope defects and rerun affected evidence.
verification.expected_result: The product is runnable and manually exercised through its core workflow; all implementation-scoped acceptance criteria and required checks have current passing evidence, with cleanup complete and IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md covering every ID. Required blocked checks prevent completion; optional or out-of-scope limitations never imply production activation.
verification.evidence_required: Sanitized commands, exit codes, manual trial steps and observed result, defect/fix summary, coverage summary, limitations, cleanup result, and final source fingerprint.
verification.cleanup: Stop task-owned processes, retain only declared evidence, and leave production inactive.
